text_to_image_prompt: Create a photorealistic character head-and-shoulders turnaround on a solid pure white background, landscape 1536 x 1024. Three equally sized portraits of one identical woman in a horizontal row: left strictly frontal looking straight at the camera, center exact 90-degree profile facing image-right, right exact 180-degree back view facing away. Entire hairstyle and accessories visible, aligned head scale and height, close portrait framing ending below the shoulders. Soft balanced bright studio illumination, natural skin texture, realistic hair strands and coherent warm-neutral grading. Level eyes and balanced cheeks in the front view, centered nose, philtrum, lips and chin, upright head and neutral relaxed expression. The profile has only its near eye visible, and the rear reveals no face. No text, labels, logos, watermark, frames or scenery. Character appearance and clothing: Dark center-parted hair in two long braids, silver over-ear headphones, warm tan freckled skin, gray-green eyes, strong dark eyebrows, full nude lips. Navy ribbed camisole. Both long braids hang in front of the shoulders. In the rear view, only their continuous roots and short sections descending along the neck sides to the shoulder tops are visible, disappearing forward behind the shoulders. No full braids or tails hang on the back.
original_prompt: Precisely edit ONLY the RIGHTMOST BACK VIEW in this 1536x1024 character turnaround sheet. Fix the unnatural back hair: currently the braids seem to end as little tucked lumps behind the ears. They are actually two LONG flexible gravity-hanging braids carried in FRONT of her shoulders, as clearly visible in the LEFT FRONT and MIDDLE PROFILE. Reconstruct anatomically plausible continuous braid paths in the rear view: center-parted dark hair gathered to two low braid bases below the headphone cups; from each base a short section of woven braid descends naturally down the lateral sides of the neck toward the shoulder tops, curving gently forward around the neck, then disappears through occlusion by the shoulder/neck toward the chest. Show enough of this short vertical-to-forward transition to make the continuous long braids believable. No abruptly cut braid ends at the nape, no tucked braid buns, no coiled hair, no hair ties at the nape, no projecting hooks, no floating braids. The full lengths and end ties are in front and therefore NOT visible running down her back. Keep rear neck and central upper back clear; the short rear-visible sections remain lateral and naturally weighted. Keep headphones, hair density, color, face identity, outfit, white background, light and overall composition. Keep left front and middle profile panels unchanged. Output full three-panel 1536x1024 sheet, no text.
